issue_context.title: Onion Skin Loop through tag frames not working correctly
issue_context.body:
The onion skin option "Loop through tag frames" has stopped working recently. While having the setup to onion skin the last and next frames, when at the start of a tagged group of frames, it will show the last frame out of the tag, and when at the end of a tagged group of frames, it will show the first two frames

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43629991/223775023-844c28a0-1b85-49fa-8703-a900b9bfda90.mp4

### Aseprite and System version

* Aseprite version: Aseprite v1.3-rc1-x64 Steam [Beta]
* System: Windows 10 Pro 10.0.19044 Build 19044 x64
comments: Thanks for this report! I was able to reproduce it.

review_comments: I think in our tests and code `frameDelta` is always +1 or -1, but what happen if it's +2 or -2? (it looks like the while could be infinite). Is it necessary to replace the original code?
Oh sorry, it looks fine, in some way so something like frame += frameDelta, I think this is fine.
